![security-high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/security-high-priority.svg) ![high](https://www.gstatic.com/codereviewagent/high-priority.svg)

Running pull request workflows from untrusted forks on self-hosted runners (especially a local WSL machine) poses a severe security risk. Even though production-like secrets are blocked, arbitrary code execution on the host machine can compromise local files, credentials, and the local network.

If this temporary bridge is absolutely necessary, please ensure that:
1. The GitHub repository settings for **Actions** -> **Fork pull request workflows** is set to **'Require approval for all outside collaborators'** or **'Require approval for all pull requests'** to prevent automatic execution of untrusted code.
2. The local WSL runner is heavily sandboxed and has no access to sensitive local network resources or host credentials.
